message.reasoning_content: Record description update. Key risk: midpoint rule with 32 points vs frequencies up to 220 rad — only ~0.4 points per period at 220 rad/t? Period 2π/220 ≈ 0.0286 → ~35 samples/period? Actually grid spacing 1/32≈0.031, so at f=220, f*h≈6.9 rad > π — aliasing, severe sampling error. Relative tolerance 0.035; amplitudes ~0.1. Error per row bounded by sum |a_k|*(2π/f?) no — midpoint rule error per term ≤ |a_k| * f * h²? Error for midpoint on sin(ft+φ): exact average = (cos φ − cos(φ+f))/f; quadrature error ≤ f/24 * h²... roughly |a_k| f² h²/24? For f=220: f²h²/24 = 220²/(32²·24)=48400/24576≈1.97, times |a|~0.1 → ~0.2 per term, potentially large. Actually exact average of a sin term is at most |a|*(2/f) ≤ 0.4 for f=0.5. Reference norm ~? Reference near 1 each row. So error could exceed 0.035·||ref||. This is the main claim surface for Skeptic.
